items.title: Lucky Block Teens!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The Lucky Block Teens have appeared in Minecraft!
Feeling lucky? Dress as a lucky block teen, mini, or even an actual lucky block!

+ 12 HD Skins
+ 1 free HD skin
+ Includes lucky block teens and more!

items.title: Cybernetic Mobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Don't be fooled by their familiar exterior... beneath their skin lurks a sinister cybernetic core designed for one thing and one thing only - total destruction! Feel powerful with these amazing skins.

- HD skins (Cyber Creeper, Cyber Enderman, Cyber Pig, Cyber Strider, Cyber Villager, and Cyber Zombie)
- Inspired by mobs and robots
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Viking Furniture HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Vikings have arrived! With swords, longboats, plenty of food, barrels and everything you need to run a rustic inn. Plus longboats, campfires, and other random props! 
+Tools to change size, color, rotation, position, etc.
+60 unique HD models
+Nearly 1000 textures/variants
+6 skins
+1 big city to decorate!

items.title: Cyber Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The future awaits you! You have been called to work on the most technologically advanced station to ever exist. Cyber Base is awaiting your arrival! 

-Futuristic spawn
-Nearby villages
-By Rareloot

items.title: PrestonPlayz Merch Pack 2
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Revolutionize your style with this pack from PrestonPlayz! Presenting 36 skins with vibrant flame designs. From the "Donut Hoodie" to the "Cactus Tee", get fired up today! Comes with 2 free!

- 2 free skins
- 36 total skins

By CinemaCraft & Preston

items.title: BriannaPlayz Hoodie Teens
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Ditch your winter gear and add some color into your style! Choose from any of these 40 hoodie skins! Over 7 color block hoodie styles to pick from! Perfect to warm up in chilly spring weather. 

- 40 total skins
- 2 free skins
- 1 Brianna skin
- Perfect for roleplay

By BriannaPlayz

items.title: American RVs
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Get ready for your road trip across America! Drive on land, sea, and air with RVs you craft using unique crafting recipes. Park at a campsite to transform RVs into Minecraft blocks. When you are ready to leave, transform them back and drive away.
- 9 RVs to drive
- 16 campsites to discover
- ATV, helicopter, boats, and more

Ride and fly across a realistic America!

items.title: Grim's Fantasy
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: Dress to impress with this mystical fantasy themed skinpack. Twelve awesome adventures ready to explore the world.

items.title: Block of Duty Zombie Survival
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: Survive endless hordes of the undead as you fight to discover the secrets behind a mad scientists dastardly experiments. How long can you survive?

items.title: PrestonPlayz Droppers
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Drop in to over 20+ droppers ranging from easy to expert difficulty! Collect Fire Tokens along the way to purchase sweet in-game merch and vehicles! There’s even a secret bonus dropper to discover. Can you survive the free fall?

Features:
- 20+ dropper maps
- Secret bonus dropper
- Lobby shop & parkour
- Singleplayer or multiplayer
- 19 skins

By CinemaCraft & Preston

items.title: Unspeakable Hide and Seek
items.creator: Meatball Inc
items.description:
Unspeakable invites you to his private island! Play against his ultimate NPC clones or against your friends! Survive to unlock ultimate power-up abilities. Spy with a drone, spawn a clone, and more! Will they find you?

- 3 huge unique maps
- 12 power-ups
- 5 unlockable merch items
- Secret mystery boxes
- 25 skins included
- 1 free skin
- Singleplayer or multiplayer

items.title: Cookie Creations!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Pick up this delicious Cookie Creations pack with various sizes and funny expressions!
Dress up as a cool cookie and have a sweet time with your friends!

+ 12 Cookie Creations skins
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes smiley, laughing, and angry cookie skins!

items.title: City Builders
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You want to build buildings? Roads? Leisure places? And build everything in a city? Well, join one of these builders by playing one of them in this City Builders pack!

+ 12 skins

items.title: Noob vs Pro
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Move your survival experience underground where you're safe and hidden!
Choose whether you want to live in a base built in 10 seconds or a millionaire's base built in more than 100 hours!

- Hide from your friends & survive!
- Live like a millionaire underground!
- Lots of fun for you to explore!

items.title: Secret Bat Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Wander past the waterfalls and discover a fully-equipped base made for heroes!
Become the mastermind with high-end facilities fitting for a technological expert!

- Jet black car, motorbike, and helicopter!
- Control-able waterfall entrance and helicopter entrance!
- A hidden base inside a cave!

items.title: Portal to Millionaire's Bunker
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The obsidian portal leads to the nether, but where does this quartz portal lead?
A multi-million bunker! Pass through the portal and see what lies beyond for yourself!

- 4 multi-million supercars!
- Open/closeable gates!
- Working lift inside the bunker!
- Huge bunker to explore!
- Vast farmland outside the bunker!

items.title: Animal Cosplay
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Cuteness overload! Put on your onesie and travel the world showing how cute, fluffy, fuzzy, or feathery you are!

- 8 unique skins!
- 1 FREE skin!
- Includes panda, white fox, penguin, and much more!

items.title: Portal to Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The obsidian portal leads to the nether, but where does this iron block portal go?
A millionaire's mansion! Hop into the special portal and travel to your dream home!

- 2 Millionaire's supercars!
- Dock and jet-ski!
- Huge Millionaire's mansion!
- Live alone or with your friends!

items.title: Evil Overlord Simulator
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Welcome to your kingdom, Overlord. Will you rule with mercy or with an iron fist?
Use your powers to collect taxes, send villagers to the dungeon and control guards.
Or choose to lead a simpler life as a knight or villager instead!
Multiplayer ready!

- Start with royal body guards who will fight for you!
- NPC dialogue changes depending on your role within the kingdom!

items.title: Minecraft: The Mountain
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
A thrilling adventure map inspired by the all-new novel Minecraft: The Mountain by Max Brooks, bestselling author of Minecraft: The Island! Explore the world from the book and the mountain base that Guy and Summer leave behind. Defeat mobs, complete mini-games, and complete a scavenger hunt to unlock the rewards that will make their base your own!
+ By Blockception

items.title: Sakura City Superheroes
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Humans made robots to assist them with day-to-day tasks, but they have gone rogue and now want to take over the world! It's now up to you to save humanity by fighting your way through Sakura City and defeating the evil Oyabun robots. Do you have what it takes to save the world?

+ Resource pack for 1.16
+ 2 high-speed vehicles
+ Over 10 different robot enemies
+ 40 skins

items.title: Parkour City Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Freerun your way from rooftop to rooftop in a city or jump from skyblock island to another! These parkour city teens are the best at what they do, go join them in beating epic pro parkour maps!

-20 skins
-1 free skin
-By inPixel

items.title: Jolicraft's AHHHHHHH!!! HD
items.creator: Jolicraft
items.description:
There are times in life where you need to be quiet. Like in school, or in libraries. And then there are times to be LOUD! Get your screaming voices ready and get some "AHHHHHHH!!!" in your life!
+ Now YOU can "AHHHHHHH!!!" in Minecraft!
+ 16 screaming skins to choose from!
+ Goes great with JOLICRAFT texture pack!

items.title: Farm Life
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Farm life is a beautiful place to roleplay with your friends. Be a farmer and visit the world "Farm Life". 

- Roleplay
- Farm
- Animals
- Windmill

Created by Mine-North
